text: The athenahealth docs site (docs.athenahealth.com) is a Contentful SPA. API reference pages with full field-level documentation are available via the exploreDocs endpoint: https://docs.athenahealth.com/v1/api/entries/exploreDocs?urlAlias=<slug>&include=5 (e.g., slug='api-ref-patient-cases'). This returns OpenAPI-style schemas with field names, types, and descriptions in primaryEndpoints[].outputParameters. Bulk-download all slugs found in the export documentation to get complete field inventories. FHIR R4 endpoint slugs return 404 (they use standard FHIR specs instead).

Patient Cases documents portal messages — map to Patient Portal Messages domain. The Patient Cases API spec (api-ref-patient-cases) confirms this: it covers clinical phone calls, portal messages, and other patient interactions routed through the clinical inbox.
